en: The image shows a vintage telegram form labeled 'ΤΗΛΕΓΡΑΦΗΜΑ' in Greek at the top, dated 27 May 1967. The telegram includes sender and receiver details, with various fields filled out in both Greek and English. The main message is typed in block letters in Greek and English, containing requests related to religious icons. There is a stamp from the Greek telecommunications authority (ΟΤΕ) and various handwritten annotations.
